constraints: rangeUpdate is only honored when targetObj is a range; it is ignored if targetObj is an element or document.
If nbCols and nbRows are omitted, a new table with 0 columns and 0 rows is created; rows/columns can then be added with WP Table append row.
If targetObj is itself a table, the newly inserted table replaces it or is inserted before/after it depending on mode; inserting a table inside another table is not possible.
